capacity.n: min(5, available semantic resources, available positive lexical resources)

arms.lexical: top n positive-scoring resources under canonical content-BM25 plus 0.25 * filename-stem-BM25
arms.semantic: top n distinct resources by semantic resource score
arms.structural: not an Increment-26 candidate input, modifier, capacity control, or judgment input

execution.custom_code: trust_remote_code=True at the pinned model revision only
execution.determinism: CPU execution; stable input order; no stochastic sampling; exact replay identity required subject to documented numerical-runtime limits.

falsification: no useful semantic-only resource appears on frozen confirmation
all useful semantic resources occur in the equal-volume lexical arm
replay is not reproducible under the frozen configuration
results materially depend on undocumented truncation or runtime choices

hidden_from_new_judgment: semantic and lexical rank or score
judgment_reuse.rule: Reuse an Increment-25 usefulness judgment if and only if InformationNeed identity, parent snapshot identity, repository resource address, and usefulness semantics are identical. Candidate origin is irrelevant.

measurements: per-case and aggregate overlap, semantic-only, and lexical-only counts
USEFUL, NOT_USEFUL, and UNJUDGED counts per arm
useful overlap, semantic-only, and lexical-only resources
semantic candidates without a positive lexical rank and their positive lexical ranks when present
native semantic resource score and winning-chunk/support provenance for audit
arm exhaustion and deterministic replay identity

protocol.information_need_distinction: InformationNeed is not query text. This experiment holds the task-card lexical_query constant across independent lexical and semantic mechanisms to isolate candidate generation.
non_claims: not learned ranking or model training
not Context selection or K=5 insertion
protocol.proposition: For a frozen InformationNeed and historical parent-snapshot corpus, similarity under one pinned pretrained representation configuration may expose useful repository resources that an equal-cardinality canonical lexical surface does not expose.

chunking.coverage: tokenize without special tokens; emit ordered overlapping windows across all content tokens; add tokenizer special tokens only when encoding each window; retain the final nonempty partial window
chunking.text_decoding: reuse the already decoded immutable RepositoryTextDocument content; introduce no additional normalization or newline rewriting

document.empty_resource: produces zero chunks and no semantic resource candidate
document.serialization: raw decoded source content only; no filename, address, path, language marker, diff, changed-path metadata, or post-change content
document.source: RepositoryTextDocument resource content from the frozen parent snapshot

encoding.chunk_method: raw chunk text without instruction prefix
encoding.chunk_support: retain every chunk ordinal tied at the resource maximum; winning chunk is the lowest ordinal
encoding.normalization: L2 normalize each float32 embedding before comparison
encoding.pooling: CLS-token pooling, as declared by the pinned sentence-transformers pooling configuration
encoding.query_method: documented CodeRankEmbed query instruction prefix plus frozen lexical_query
encoding.resource_aggregation: maximum chunk similarity per repository resource
encoding.resource_tie_break: descending resource score, then ascending repository resource address
encoding.similarity: float32 dot product of L2-normalized vectors (cosine similarity)

query.overlength: reject rather than truncate when tokenized query content exceeds 2046 tokens
query.serialization: Represent this query for searching relevant code: {lexical_query}

representation.unit_boundary: Chunks are experiment-local representations, not RepositorySubjects, Repository Intelligence, retrieval candidates, or Context units. Candidate and judgment unit is one repository resource.
